items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: It was up to the producer to pick places and things, and he did. I was all for it.

ctx.x: So, that. So Marshall did the Wild Chopper Tulas album? You might say, yeah. Because that was just, to me, just a thing of beauty as it captures the street sound. Oh, yeah. Right. What made you decide to go record Motion in California? Jerry Wexton.
Right. It was up to the producer to pick places and things, and he did. I was all for it. Whoever's leading them for.

You wanted to put it in someone else's hands? Oh, yes. Lovely. What are your plans for the new album? Would that be produced locally or? Local. Very local. Will you be producing that or Marshall? Myself. I wanted two more general questions. What do you think could... Would you say, and how would you react to this statement, that some of the very strengths of New Orleans music, in that it's loose and enjoyable, or sometimes very downfall, that the musicians aren't business-like enough? that sometimes the fun…
